items.headline: Crypto rally cools as traders add to Fed hike bets ahead of Jackson Hole
items.summary: CoinDesk reports bitcoin back below $79,000 and XRP leading major-token losses as shorter-dated Treasuries weakened and traders increased expectations of a Fed rate hike; SOL was a notable relative-strength exception. Falling open interest still points more toward short covering/unwinding than broad fresh directional leverage.
items.whyItMatters: A hawkish repricing in rates can pressure crypto liquidity and risk appetite ahead of the Fed Chair's Jackson Hole keynote, while uneven token performance warns against treating the move as a uniform market signal.
items.actionReason: This is macro context, not an execution instruction. The latest available Crypto Reca Radar remains older at 20:01 Madrid on Aug. 26 and had every monitored asset below ERS 70 with no executable new long, so there is no independent Crypto Reca entry confirmation to override.

items.headline: XRP leverage rises to seven-month high as long crowding increases liquidation risk
items.summary: CoinDesk reports CryptoQuant's estimated XRP leverage ratio on Binance near 0.21, its highest since January, with roughly $3.45B open interest and futures volume above five times spot. XRP was down about 5% near $1.44, increasing the risk that further weakness could trigger forced long liquidations.
items.whyItMatters: Crowded leveraged longs can amplify an otherwise normal pullback through forced liquidations, worsening short-term liquidity and volatility conditions for XRP.
items.actionReason: This is a direct XRP risk warning, not an exit instruction. The latest Crypto Reca Radar at 20:01 Madrid independently has XRP at ERS 36 / Entry 1/5 / WATCH, still far below its roughly 1.46 reclaim, so there is no current Crypto Reca long confirmation to override.

items.headline: U.S. July PCE inflation remains sticky; Q2 GDP stays at 1.5%
items.summary: BEA reported July PCE spending +0.2% m/m and Q2 real GDP unrevised at 1.5% annualized. The release remains a macro headwind context rather than a direct crypto execution signal.
items.whyItMatters: Sticky inflation and slower growth can keep financial conditions restrictive and pressure risk appetite.
items.actionReason: The event window is over; the latest 20:01 Crypto Reca Radar still has no executable new long in the monitored universe.

items.headline: U.S. spot bitcoin ETF inflows slow sharply but remain positive on Aug. 26
items.summary: Farside's current table shows approximately $31.4M net BTC ETF inflows for Aug. 26, down from $314.3M on Aug. 25. Demand remains net positive, but the pace of institutional inflows has decelerated materially.
items.whyItMatters: A sharp slowdown in ETF inflows weakens the near-term demand impulse without yet reversing it.
items.actionReason: Still-positive flows are supportive context only; Crypto Reca remains below entry thresholds and positive news cannot create a buy signal.

items.headline: U.S. crypto ETFs post broad inflows on Aug. 25; bitcoin streak confirmed at seven sessions
items.summary: Finalized flow data showed $314.3M net inflows for BTC on Aug. 25 alongside positive regulated-product flows across several major crypto assets.
items.whyItMatters: Broad regulated-product inflows support spot-demand context across major crypto assets.
items.actionReason: Positive flows do not create a Crypto Reca entry or override technical hard gates.

items.headline: Crypto consolidates after the weekly surge as bitcoin holds near $79,000
items.summary: CoinDesk reported BTC consolidating around $79,000 after a strong weekly advance, with futures open interest declining alongside the pullback. That pattern is more consistent with position unwinding than a verified build of fresh shorts.
items.whyItMatters: The rally is consolidating rather than clearly reversing, but the prior move leaves fresh longs exposed to poor location and volatility.
items.actionReason: The 20:01 Crypto Reca Radar has all six assets below ERS 70 and no executable new long.

items.headline: U.S. spot Solana ETFs extend inflow streak and cumulative demand
items.summary: U.S. spot SOL ETFs added $33.5M on Aug. 24, extending a multi-session positive flow run.
items.whyItMatters: Persistent regulated-product inflows strengthen institutional-demand context for SOL.
items.actionReason: No fresh executable trigger is independently confirmed by Crypto Reca.

items.headline: Solana supply-governance status clarified: SIMD-553 approved and merged; SIMD-550 vote remains ongoing
items.summary: 21Shares confirms SIMD-553 was approved and merged by Anza and Firedancer on July 20, while SIMD-550 advanced to SGP-0002 and has been in a stake-weighted vote since Aug. 23. The prior Intelligence wording that both supply measures remained unapproved proposals was therefore inaccurate.
items.whyItMatters: SIMD-553's approval means part of the supply-policy package has already advanced beyond proposal status, while the larger disinflation change still depends on the SGP-0002 vote; validator-cost details also remain unresolved.
items.actionReason: This corrects the fundamental context but does not create an entry. The latest Crypto Reca Radar still has SOL below entry thresholds and no completed trigger.

items.headline: Bitcoin pulls back after the U.S. inflation release
items.summary: BTC weakened after the PCE release and later stabilized. This remains an observed market reaction, not an independent exit signal.
items.whyItMatters: The market absorbed part of the post-PCE pullback, but short-term consolidation remains active after a large weekly move.
items.actionReason: Do not infer an exit or new entry from price reaction alone; Crypto Reca risk/structure rules remain controlling.

items.headline: Ethereum researchers propose first validator-deposit step toward quantum-resistant staking
items.summary: Ethereum researchers proposed a draft redesign of the validator deposit contract to support future quantum-resistant signature systems. The proposal is early-stage and does not represent an enacted protocol change.
items.whyItMatters: The proposal addresses a long-horizon cryptographic risk to staking infrastructure but has no immediate execution implication.
items.actionReason: Early draft only; no current Crypto Reca gate should change from this item.
